ConCommands.Name: impersonate
ConCommands.HelpString: Impersonate a player (custom dll required, looks weird for vanilloids) - Usage: impersonate "<player namepart>" "<message>"

ConCommands.Name: spoofNetworkName
ConCommands.HelpString: Spoof your name when chatting in networks (this gets automatically reset) - Usage: spoofNetworkName "<name>" (\\n for newlines)

ConCommands.Name: spoofNetworkName_inf
ConCommands.HelpString: Keep spoofing your name when chatting in networks (the name gets automatically re-spoofed every 5s) - Usage: spoofNetworkName_inf "<name>"

ConCommands.Name: clearNetworkName
ConCommands.HelpString: Restore your default network chat name (this also stops the _inf spoof) - Usage: clearNetworkName

ConCommands.Name: sendNetworkMsg
ConCommands.HelpString: Send a message to your current network - Usage: sendNetworkMsg "<message>" optional: "<name>" "<room>"

ConCommands.Name: viewUser
ConCommands.HelpString: Print user data for the specified uid - Usage: viewUser "<uid"

ConCommands.Name: inviteToCommunity
ConCommands.HelpString: Invite user or entire lobby to a community - Usage: inviteToCommunity "<community id>" "<uid>" OR: "true"

ConCommands.Name: sendOpenInvite
ConCommands.HelpString: Start open invite - Usage: sendOpenInvite "<communityID>" optional: "<name>" "<duration>" "<playlist>" "<numSlots>"

ConCommands.Name: scan4parties
ConCommands.HelpString: Scan a network for open parties - Usage: scan4parties "<communityID>"

ConCommands.Name: bigScan4parties
ConCommands.HelpString: Scan *many* networks for open parties - Usage: bigScan4parties "<max communities>" "<min members>"

ConCommands.Name: viewCommunity
ConCommands.HelpString: Print community data for the specified community id - Usage: viewCommunity "<community id>"
